title: Trial of Spiritual Care Interventions for Patients With Cancer
official: Trial of Spiritual Care Interventions for Patients With Cancer
summary: This study aims to determine the effects of 2 spiritual care interventions. Spiritual wellness and healthcare service utilization will be measured from a sample of advanced cancer patients recruited from outpatient settings.
criteria:
1. Diagnosed with an advanced cancer.
2. Member of a religious faith community organization.
3. Fluent in English.

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Received spiritual care from a healthcare chaplain within the past 2 months.
2. Too weak or cognitively impaired to engage in study activities.
sponsor: Weill Medical College of Cornell University

sites.f: New York Presbyterian Brooklyn Methodist Hospital
The University of Texas Medical Branch, Galveston
